title: AP Biology Midterm
subtitle: Units 0–4 · multiple choice and free response
subject: Biology

settings.intro:
Two panes: stimulus on the left, question and answers on the right. Free-response subparts each have their own answer box. Tools: calculator, notes, text highlighting, light/dark theme.

  • The exam runs in full screen. Leaving full screen or the tab is recorded and shown to your teacher.
  • Section I (multiple choice) and Section II (free response) are timed separately, 90 minutes each. You cannot return to Section I once you start Section II. You will be warned at 30, 10, 5 and 1 minutes.
  • Time is tracked per question.
  • Answers save automatically to your teacher’s dashboard.
